response.justification: Bogdan is a technically strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source, Linux, and architecture experience (including founding and running his own platform), but the role explicitly requires C1 German proficiency and he lists only 'Basic' German. Combined with no clear prior title or experience in formal team leadership, project management, or client-facing architecture advisory (the core of this Head of Development role), this is a significant mismatch despite his solid engineering background.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, hands-on software development across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems
Deep open-source and Linux experience, including founding and maintaining a self-hosted, Kubernetes-deployable platform (GISCollective)
Demonstrated architecture and systems design skill (low-latency DLang services, GIS platform design, CI/CD infrastructure setup)
concerns: German listed as only 'Basic', far below the required C1 minimum for client-facing advisory work
No job titles or explicit experience indicating formal team leadership, mentoring, or people management
No mention of Python, UML, or formal requirements-management/IT security & compliance experience

key_factors.factor: German language level (Basic vs required C1)
Lack of formal leadership/team management experience
